text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to having the day off, I was able 
to buy tickets to the Umamusume event~~!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
"A talk show, interactive games, and even 
a mini-concert—it's jam-packed... 
Absolutely amazing!!"

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Aaagh, just thinking about it makes me 
unable to contain myself! I've gotta burn 
off this energy right now!! What are we 
doing today, Trainer-san!?

Agnes Digital had a fulfilling day off and 
seems to have fully recharged her energy.
